cards.name: Alesha's Arena
cards.oracle_text:
When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, You may mill three cards.
Whenever you attack, return target creature card with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Whenever chaos ensues, put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. It gains first strike until end of turn.

cards.name: Bagel Valley
cards.oracle_text:
When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, put an everything counter on target creature or land you control. (It has all creature types or all land types.)
Whenever you attack, discover X, where X is number of everything counters among permanents.
Whenever chaos ensues, for each permanent you control with an everything counter on it, create a token that's a copy of it.

cards.name: Demo Tables
cards.oracle_text:
Play the Game, See the World — When you planeswalk here, each player may search their library for a basic land card, put it into their hand, then shuffle.
Here I Rule — Whenever you play a basic land card or a card with a Foundations or core set expansion symbol (Alpha counts!), draw a card.
Ignite Your Spark — Whenever chaos ensues, you gain life equal to the number of years you've played Magic. Then planeswalk.

cards.name: Elvish Impersonation Contest (Phenomenon)
cards.oracle_text:
When you encounter this phenomenon, each player creates an Elvish Impersonators token. You become the monarch. (It's a green Elf creature with "As this creature enters, roll a six-sided die twice. Its base power becomes the first result and its base toughness becomes the second result." and flavor text "Uh-hunh.")
(Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

cards.name: Jalira's Showroom
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card, then discard a card.
Whenever chaos ensues, destroy up to one target creature. Its controller reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card. That player puts that card onto the battlefield, then puts the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order.

cards.name: Samut's Training Grounds
cards.oracle_text:
Creature spells cost {1} less to cast.
Creatures you control have haste.
Whenever chaos ensues, until end of turn, creatures you control can't be blocked except by creatures with haste.

cards.name: The Merch Booth
cards.oracle_text:
When you planeswalk here, at the beginning of your upkeep, and whenever you roll the planar die, you get ❖. Spend ❖ only during your turn.
❖ — Create a Food token.
❖ ❖ — Create a 1/1 colorless Toy artifact creature token named Fblthp.
❖ ❖ ❖ ❖ — Draw two cards.

cards.name: Ureni's Lair
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever one or more creatures you control enter during your turn, put a flying counter on one of them. It becomes a Spirit Dragon with base power and toughness 5/5 in addition to its other types. This ability triggers only once each turn.
Whenever chaos ensues, Dragons you control gain menace and haste until end of turn.

cards.name: You Encounter a Beholder!
cards.oracle_text:
When you encounter this phenomenon, starting with you, each player rolls a d20. Players who control their commander roll with advantage. (They roll 2d20 and ignore the lower roll.)
1-9 | Create a Treasure token.
10-19 | Draw a card.
20 | Create a Treasure token, draw a card, then you may cast a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
(Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)
